# Shiliaiwei Liquid Glass Design System — LLM Context & Agent Skill Specification (llms.txt)

> **Authoritative Specification**: This document contains the complete, uncompressed architectural rules, design system tokens, visual standards, physics rules, audio synthesis blueprints, component implementations, and multi-platform standards for the Shiliaiwei Liquid Glass Design DNA.

- **Production URL**: https://shiliaiwei.pages.dev
- **Cloudflare Pages Project**: shiliaiwei
- **Design Standard**: Shiliaiwei Solid Liquid Glass Architecture v2.4.0
- **Typography**: Outfit (English/Latin), Google Sans & Kantumruy Pro (Khmer), JetBrains Mono (Code/Tokens)

---

## 1. The 16 Immutable Architectural Directives

1. **Directive 1: ZERO EMOJI POLICY**
   - Emojis (smileys, flames, rockets, checks, sparkles, flags, symbols) are strictly forbidden across all UI code, documentation, scripts, and assistant responses.

2. **Directive 2: ZERO ICONS & ZERO DECORATIVE GLYPHS (PURE TYPOGRAPHY)**
   - No icon fonts (Font Awesome, Material Symbols, Lucide, Heroicons), no arbitrary Unicode glyphs, and no decorative symbols.
   - Use high-contrast monospace code tokens, semantic status pills (`ACTIVE`, `PROD`, `VERIFIED`, `ENABLED`, `PENDING`), and pure typography labels.

3. **Directive 3: ZERO GRAY (NO MUDDY/DULL GRAYS)**
   - No generic dull or muddy grays (`#808080`, `#999999`, `#cccccc`).
   - High-contrast Canvas White (`#FAFCFF`, `#FFFFFF`) paired with Slate-900 typography (`#0F172A`), Slate-600 (`#475569`), and Slate-500 (`#64748B`).

4. **Directive 4: ZERO GRADIENTS (100% SOLID COLORS ONLY)**
   - No linear, radial, mesh, or conic gradients. Every element uses single solid color tokens.

5. **Directive 5: ZERO MIX COLOR**
   - Exactly ONE solid color token per element. No color blending, gradient fills, or rainbow overlays.

6. **Directive 6: STRICT CLOSED COLOR PALETTE (8 CORE TOKENS)**
   - NEVER use, invent, or introduce colors outside the explicit `:root` tokens.
   - Closed Palette (8 of 8):
     - `01. Canvas White`: `#FAFCFF` (`--bg-main`) — High-contrast canvas foundation.
     - `02. Slate-900`: `#0F172A` (`--text-main`) — Master typography & solid borders (16.8:1 AAA contrast).
     - `03. Primary Emerald`: `#10B981` (`--primary`) — Core brand interactive actions and confirmations.
     - `04. Deep Emerald`: `#059669` (`--primary-dark`) — 3D depth extrusion and high-contrast text.
     - `05. Eager Green`: `#58CC02` (`--color-eager-green`) — High-energy CTA buttons.
     - `06. Spark Blue`: `#1CB0F6` (`--color-spark-blue`) — Secondary interactive accents.
     - `07. Accent Cyan`: `#0891B2` (`--accent-cyan`) — Release tags and code chips.
     - `08. Accent Crimson`: `#FF0050` (`--accent-crimson`) — Critical alerts and danger states.

7. **Directive 7: ZERO SHADOW & ZERO GLOW**
   - No blurry drop shadows or ambient glow orbs. All elements use crisp solid borders (`border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.10); border-top: 1px solid #FFFFFF; box-shadow: none;`).

8. **Directive 8: ZERO HOVER STYLE (NO FLOATING/LIFTING HOVERS)**
   - No hover lifts (`translateY`), shadow alterations, or background swaps. Layouts remain static and stable until directly clicked or activated.

9. **Directive 9: REALISTIC MESSAGE DATA & TAP-CURSOR AUTO-CLEAR**
   - Input fields pre-filled with realistic production messages that auto-clear on focus/tap and restore on empty blur.

10. **Directive 10: MANDATORY GOOGLE SANS FOR KHMER & 9px TACTILE STICKER BUTTONS**
    - All Khmer text strictly uses `'Google Sans', 'Kantumruy Pro', sans-serif`.
    - Standard Button radius: **`9px`** (`var(--radius-buttons)`), Compact: **`6px`** (`var(--radius-sm)`).
    - 3D bottom shadow depth (`0 4px 0 <depth-color>`) with active click compression (`transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 <depth-color>;`).

11. **Directive 11: APPLE IPHONE & MACOS DESKTOP APP ICON HERO**
    - Outer Squircle Frame: `118px × 118px` (`100px × 100px` mobile), `border-radius: 28px`, solid emerald `#10B981` with crisp `1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.14)` outline (zero white rim).
    - Inner Apple Geometry Guide Grid: Concentric circle and crosshairs.
    - 3D Elevated Center Plate: `72px × 72px`, `#059669`, `border-radius: 16px`, `border-top: 2px solid #FFFFFF`.
    - Emblem: Pure white Khmer **"វី"** typography (`font-size: 3.1rem; font-weight: 900`).
    - Audio Synthesis: Web Audio API crystal glass chime sound effect on tap.

12. **Directive 12: UNTRANSLATED PROPER NAMES POLICY**
    - Proper names, personal names, brand identities, and technical product titles (`Shiliaiwei`, `Kosal Chan`, `PostgreSQL`, `CSS`, `Google Sans`, `Outfit`) must **NEVER** be translated to Khmer. They must remain in their original Latin/English form.

13. **Directive 13: TEXT BOUNDARY LIMIT & AUTO-WRAP MANDATE**
    - All text blocks, badges, table cells, and paragraphs must wrap naturally (`overflow-wrap: break-word; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word;`). Single-line overflow and clipping are forbidden.

14. **Directive 14: CONCISE 2–3 WORDS BUTTON TEXT MANDATE**
    - Every interactive button across all applications, modules, and dialogs must strictly use **two or three words maximum** (`Verify Code`, `Resend Code`, `Save Settings`, `Create Key`, `Export CSV`, `Next Step`, `Back Step`, `Confirm Payment`, `Send Message`, `Invite User`, `Delete Key`, `Switch KM`, `Copy Tokens`, `Prompt`).

15. **Directive 15: SINGLE-VIEW STUDIO ARCHITECTURE**
    - 3 dedicated views (`Visual Identity`, `UI Elements`, `Web App Suite`) selectable from the top sticky floating capsule dock with zero forced scrolling.

16. **Directive 16: MANDATORY PERSISTENT DESIGN RECORD RULE**
    - Every design decision, component rule, physics standard, and platform specification must **ALWAYS** be permanently recorded into `DESIGN_DNA.md`, `llms.txt`, and synchronized across all agent skills.

---

## 2. Complete CSS Design Tokens (`:root`)

```css
:root {
  /* Canvas & Glass Foundations */
  --bg-main: #FAFCFF;
  --bg-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  --bg-surface-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  --bg-surface-elevated: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  --bg-inner-glass: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.85);
  
  /* Specular Highlight Borders */
  --border-glass: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
  --border-glass-top: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
  --border-glass-hover: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.70);
  --glass-shadow: none;
  --glass-shadow-hover: none;
  
  /* The 8 Closed Color System Tokens */
  --primary: #10B981;
  --primary-dark: #059669;
  --primary-light: #065F46;
  --color-eager-green: #58CC02;
  --color-spark-blue: #1CB0F6;
  --accent-cyan: #0891B2;
  --accent-cyan-light: #0E7490;
  --accent-crimson: #FF0050;
  
  /* High-Contrast Bold Slate Typography */
  --text-main: #0F172A;
  --text-muted: #475569;
  --text-dim: #64748B;
  
  /* Typography Families */
  --font-sans: 'Outfit', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-en: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  --font-km: 'Google Sans', 'Kantumruy Pro', sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  
  /* Spatial Hierarchy & Radii */
  --spacing-unit: 4px;
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-buttons: 9px;
  --radius-md: 10px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 22px;
  --radius-pill: 9999px;
}
```

## 3. The 14 Core UI Elements Specifications

### 1. Tactile Buttons (`.btn`)
- **Primary CTA (`.btn-primary`)**:
  ```css
  background-color: #10B981;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  border-top: 1.5px solid #FFFFFF;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #059669;
  ```
- **Eager Green Sticker (`.btn-eager`)**:
  ```css
  background-color: #58CC02;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #46A302;
  ```
- **Spark Blue (`.btn-spark`)**:
  ```css
  background-color: #FFFFFF;
  color: #0284C7;
  border: 2px solid #BAE6FD;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #BAE6FD;
  ```
- **Active Press State**:
  ```css
  .btn:active {
    transform: translateY(3px);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 currentColor;
  }
  ```

## 4. Web Audio API Notification Sound Synthesizer

```javascript
function playMacNotificationSound() {
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();

    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    // Primary E6 -> A6 crystal tone
    const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain1 = ctx.createGain();
    osc1.type = 'sine';
    osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(1318.51, now);
    osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1760.00, now + 0.08);
    gain1.gain.setValueAtTime(0.32, now);
    gain1.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.45);
    osc1.connect(gain1);
    gain1.connect(ctx.destination);

    // High shimmer overtone E7
    const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain2 = ctx.createGain();
    osc2.type = 'sine';
    osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(2637.02, now);
    gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
    gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.35);
    osc2.connect(gain2);
    gain2.connect(ctx.destination);

    // Tactile transient bass pop
    const osc3 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain3 = ctx.createGain();
    osc3.type = 'triangle';
    osc3.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, now);
    osc3.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(110, now + 0.06);
    gain3.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, now);
    gain3.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.08);
    osc3.connect(gain3);
    gain3.connect(ctx.destination);

    osc1.start(now);
    osc2.start(now);
    osc3.start(now);
    osc1.stop(now + 0.45);
    osc2.stop(now + 0.35);
    osc3.stop(now + 0.08);
  } catch (err) {}
}
```

## 5. Multi-Platform Implementation References

### React / TypeScript
```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';

export const ShiliaiweiTactileButton: React.FC<{
  label: string;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'eager' | 'spark';
  onClick?: () => void;
}> = ({ label, variant = 'primary', onClick }) => {
  const styles: Record<string, React.CSSProperties> = {
    primary: {
      backgroundColor: '#10B981',
      color: '#FFFFFF',
      boxShadow: '0 4px 0 #059669',
      borderRadius: '9px',
      padding: '10px 18px',
      fontWeight: 700,
      border: 'none',
      cursor: 'pointer',
    },
    eager: {
      backgroundColor: '#58CC02',
      color: '#FFFFFF',
      boxShadow: '0 4px 0 #46A302',
      borderRadius: '9px',
      padding: '10px 18px',
      fontWeight: 700,
      border: 'none',
      cursor: 'pointer',
    },
    spark: {
      backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
      color: '#0284C7',
      border: '2px solid #BAE6FD',
      boxShadow: '0 4px 0 #BAE6FD',
      borderRadius: '9px',
      padding: '10px 18px',
      fontWeight: 700,
      cursor: 'pointer',
    }
  };

  return (
    <button style={styles[variant]} onClick={onClick}>
      {label}
    </button>
  );
};
```

### Android Jetpack Compose (Kotlin)
```kotlin
package com.shiliaiwei.design

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.shadow
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp

object ShiliaiweiColors {
    val CanvasWhite = Color(0xFFFAFCFF)
    val Slate900 = Color(0xFF0F172A)
    val PrimaryEmerald = Color(0xFF10B981)
    val DeepEmerald = Color(0xFF059669)
    val EagerGreen = Color(0xFF58CC02)
    val SparkBlue = Color(0xFF1CB0F6)
}

@Composable
fun ShiliaiweiTactileButton(
    text: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
            .background(ShiliaiweiColors.PrimaryEmerald)
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Text(
            text = text,
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = 14.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
        )
    }
}
```

### iOS SwiftUI (Swift)
```swift
import SwiftUI

struct ShiliaiweiColors {
    static let canvasWhite = Color(red: 250/255, green: 252/255, blue: 255/255)
    static let slate900 = Color(red: 15/255, green: 23/255, blue: 42/255)
    static let primaryEmerald = Color(red: 16/255, green: 185/255, blue: 129/255)
    static let deepEmerald = Color(red: 5/255, green: 150/255, blue: 105/255)
    static let eagerGreen = Color(red: 88/255, green: 204/255, blue: 2/255)
    static let sparkBlue = Color(red: 28/255, green: 176/255, blue: 246/255)
}

struct ShiliaiweiTactileButton: View {
    let title: String
    let action: () -> Void
    
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundColor(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, 18)
                .padding(.vertical, 10)
                .background(ShiliaiweiColors.primaryEmerald)
                .cornerRadius(9)
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9)
                        .stroke(Color.white.opacity(0.4), lineWidth: 1)
                )
        }
        .buttonStyle(PlainButtonStyle())
    }
}
```

### Flutter (Dart)
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ShiliaiweiColors {
  static const Color canvasWhite = Color(0xFFFAFCFF);
  static const Color slate900 = Color(0xFF0F172A);
  static const Color primaryEmerald = Color(0xFF10B981);
  static const Color deepEmerald = Color(0xFF059669);
  static const Color eagerGreen = Color(0xFF58CC02);
  static const Color sparkBlue = Color(0xFF1CB0F6);
}

class ShiliaiweiTactileButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final VoidCallback onPressed;

  const ShiliaiweiTactileButton({
    Key? key,
    required this.label,
    required this.onPressed,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ElevatedButton(
      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: ShiliaiweiColors.primaryEmerald,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 4,
        shadowColor: ShiliaiweiColors.deepEmerald,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
        ),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 10),
      ),
      onPressed: onPressed,
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```
